title: AI Engineer | Foundation Models | Pre-training & Post-training
about_me_p:
I’m Andrés Landazábal, a Colombian systems engineer and AI engineer based in Japan, with more than five and a half years of experience in the IT industry. I bring a systems perspective to AI: understanding the model, building the software around it, and keeping the complete system working.

My AI background is rooted in machine learning and deep learning. I’ve trained models using supervised learning, neural networks, and Transformer architectures, working with Python, NumPy, PyTorch, and TensorFlow. I’ve also trained image models using attention mechanisms, diffusion, and U-Net architectures. Today, I apply that foundation to foundation-model pre-training and post-training, including LoRA, SFT, DPO, and model evaluation.

I build, deploy, and maintain AI systems, connecting models to APIs, backends, and web applications, with Docker and Kubernetes supporting deployment and operation. I care about understanding why a system works, identifying where it fails, and improving it over time. For your project, that means an engineer who can work across model development, application integration, and ongoing maintenance.
